changes: Use standalone public Material/Cupertino UI packages for widgets, themes, and localizations.
Declare required UI dependencies and Flutter >=3.47.0; retain upstream Dart language and platform contracts.
Use material_ui GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegates in the nested FeedbackLocalization, preserving delegate precedence and locale selection.
Keep this repository-local compatibility fork unpublished (publish_to: none).
Remove the inactive raw-print comment in lib/src/feedback_builder/string_feedback.dart; the comment cleanup does not change runtime behavior.

In lib/src/feedback_widget.dart, check context.mounted after awaiting feedback submission before resolving BetterFeedback and hiding the editor; replace the previous use_build_context_synchronously suppression with this lifecycle guard.
Add a prominent local-modification header to every modified Dart file and pubspec.yaml; preserve all original copyright text and LICENSE bytes.

In lib/src/feedback_widget.dart, resolve FeedbackTheme and derive ThemeData inside the retained OverlayEntry.builder, so the editor updates across runtime dark/light theme changes; preserve the existing screenshot, animation, controls, and submission behavior.
Remove the unnecessary named library declaration while retaining the public export surface.

Replace deprecated dart:js context lookup with a nullable @JS flutterCanvasKit getter from dart:js_interop; preserve the renderer warning behavior for null or undefined globals and the existing conditional import.

Stop populating the deprecated ColorScheme.background role. Preserve the previous light/dark surface defaults and all caller-supplied color schemes; FeedbackThemeData.background still colors the feedback canvas directly.
